purpose: Check whether public sources expose a specimen voucher/accession crosswalk or a named-waterbody and coordinate crosswalk for the six stations in the 2025 RSU San Agustin fish survey; prepare a transparent author inquiry if the missing metadata is not publicly available.

method.scope: Read the public full-text article and publisher record, inspect the browser-readable peer-review-history page, and check the related 2023 Tablas freshwater study for a public 2025 voucher or station crosswalk.
method.distinction: The 2025 article reports that preserved specimens were held at the RSU San Agustin Campus Biological Repository. It gives Table 2 station codes A-F and reach labels, but does not publish a specimen catalogue/accession list, individually named tributary rivers, or a coordinate for each station. The methods also print approximately 12.6010, 122.1924 and a conflicting parenthetical coordinate string. Do not normalize these into mapped station geometry.
method.accessLimit: The publisher's open-review page exposes links to reviewer reports, a revised Word manuscript, and a ZIP feedback file. The web source viewer rejected those Word/ZIP files as unsupported content types, so their contents were not examined. No conclusion is made about what those uninspected files may contain. A separate 2023 Tablas freshwater article says its own specimens were held at the same RSU repository; it does not crosswalk those distinct specimens to the 2025 survey.
method.sourceReuse: Only concise attributed findings and direct links are retained. No reviewer file, full article, specimen image, sequence, or coordinates were copied into this review. The attached inquiry is a draft only and was not sent.

findings.question: Are voucher or accession identifiers publicly linked to the 2025 Table 1 labels?
findings.finding: No voucher catalogue number or specimen-to-label crosswalk is visible in the reviewed full text, publisher record, or browser-readable peer-review-history page. The paper states that specimens were preserved and stored at RSU San Agustin Campus for identification. This is a bounded public-source search, not proof that the repository has no catalogue or that the inaccessible reviewer attachments contain no additional metadata.
findings.disposition: Keep all 39 taxon rows as source labels only. None is verified as a specimen-level occurrence by this review.

findings.question: Can the A-F stations be mapped to individually named rivers or exact coordinates?
findings.finding: Table 2 maps A to river mouth/estuary, B and C to River 1 lower/middle reaches, and D, E, and F to River 2 lower/middle/upper reaches. The article does not provide official river names or per-station coordinates. Its general locality coordinates are inconsistent: `12.6010, 122.1924` and `12.36' North 122.8 East` are both printed without a station-by-station link.
findings.disposition: Do not create a waterbody geometry, snap the survey to a public river line, or assign station presence to a named river until the coordinate format and station crosswalk are authoritatively clarified.

findings.question: Does the related 2023 Tablas freshwater paper resolve the 2025 samples?
findings.finding: No. The 2023 paper reports a separate island-wide freshwater survey and states its own specimens were stored at the RSU San Agustin Campus Biological Repository. It does not provide a 2025 survey voucher or A-F station crosswalk; shared repository custody does not establish that two surveys' samples are the same.
findings.disposition: Use the 2023 records only in their separately attributed review; do not use them as a substitute for the requested 2025 crosswalk.

requestDraft.recipient: Corresponding author using the contact published with the article; no message has been sent.
asksFor: whether specimens remain in the repository and any accession or voucher IDs linked to source labels
A-F station-to-waterbody/reach names and a station map or coordinates
the intended coordinate format, datum, and whether the published coordinate is a campus point or sampling station
diagnostic or sequence-to-voucher evidence for uncertain labels
attribution, permission, and reuse terms for the crosswalk metadata
requestDraft.projectDisclosure: The draft states Bangwit is an independent personal project with intended Philippines-wide scope and a Cavite pilot, is not affiliated with RSU, and has not added these article rows to public maps.

nextAction: The prepared author inquiry is not sent. The user can send it using the contact listed with the paper. Until a response supplies verifiable specimen and station links and reuse conditions, do not admit the San Agustin study as species-by-waterbody occurrence rows. Continue independent regional data work that does not depend on this response.

sources.supports: Public author-uploaded full text reviewed for repository custody, sample preservation, general coordinate notation, Table 2 A-F reach labels, and the absence of per-specimen accession identifiers in the main paper.
